# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the current `main` branch and the latest distributed Currency build. Older builds and historical release branches do not receive separate security backports. Update to the latest available build before checking whether an issue still occurs.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Email the maintainer at dimasike.dev@gmail.com. Use a subject such as `Currency security report`. GitHub private vulnerability reporting is not currently enabled for this repository.

Include the affected build or commit, device and OS version, reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept, and the potential impact. Share only the information needed to investigate; do not send credentials, real user data or other secrets.

Do not open a public issue or pull request containing vulnerability details. The maintainer will review the report and coordinate investigation, any fix and disclosure with you by email. There is no guaranteed response or fix timeline. If you have not heard back, follow up in the same email thread.

For ordinary bugs and questions, use [Support](SUPPORT.md).
